superArguments: Compile shader variants and preview a shader in the Editor. Write `.shader`, `.hlsl`, and `.compute` through an available file-writing path; when `exec_editor_script` is available, use `File.WriteAllText` + `AssetDatabase.ImportAsset`. Then call `unity_shader.compile` to compile them. Use an available material-assignment path (for example `exec_editor_script` + renderer.sharedMaterial) to assign a material that uses the shader to a renderer. Parameters: action, paths, shader_names, material_paths, variant_mode, keywords, include_passes, timeout_seconds, frames, mesh, resolution, material_path.

action.description: compile: reimport + variant warmup. Top-level success means the compile job finished; judge shader errors by error_count > 0 or has_errors, not success. Returns error_count, has_errors, and messages[]. preview: Editor PNG frames + is_error_pink. Preview animation uses _PreviewTime (not built-in _Time).

paths.description: For compile: asset paths starting with "Assets/". Accepts .shader files directly, or .hlsl/.cginc/.compute files (resolved to the .shader files that #include them).

shader_names.description: For compile/preview: shader internal names as declared in the Shader "Name/Path" block (e.g. "VFX/Ice"). Resolved via Shader.Find.

material_paths.description: For compile: material asset paths whose keyword state seeds variant compilation (variant_mode="used"/"common").

variant_mode.description: For compile: variant compilation scope. "used" = current material keywords only. "common" (default) = used + INSTANCING_ON/OFF + ShadowCaster + SRP default keywords. "explicit" = caller-supplied keyword combinations via keywords[][].

keywords.description: For compile with variant_mode="explicit": arrays of keyword combinations to compile, e.g. [["INSTANCING_ON"],["_MAIN_LIGHT_SHADOWS","INSTANCING_ON"]].

include_passes.description: For compile: pass names to include, e.g. ["ForwardLit","ShadowCaster"]. Defaults to Normal + ShadowCaster + ScriptableRenderPipeline.

timeout_seconds.description: For compile: optional timeout in seconds.

t.description: Time value written to the _PreviewTime float property for this frame. Shaders must read _PreviewTime; Unity's built-in _Time cannot be overridden in Editor preview.

props.description: Optional material property overrides for this frame. Values can be a number (float) or a 3/4-element array (vector).

frames.description: For preview: frames to render. Each entry specifies t (written to _PreviewTime) and optional per-frame property overrides. Defaults to [{t:0}]. Preview animation requires the shader to declare and use _PreviewTime.

mesh.description: For preview: built-in mesh to render the shader on. Defaults to "sphere".

resolution.description: For preview: output resolution in pixels (64–1024). Defaults to 256.

The four user images were inspected for interface structure only; account names, historical prompts and generated files were not copied into fixtures or extracted as user data.

## Provenance

The actual package root is `E:/TuanjieCodely/EXE/Tuanjie Cowork/app/resource` (singular **resource**). `cowork.exe` is 58,555,736 bytes, SHA256 `55ea13a9707774df61a707ac55179e94abb9690583de986c528da056a69b8c3b`. Actual `VscTheme-BExNMG_K.js` SHA256 is `fd4e5d8dc61d22c2f9731773f45c6a6057180f7613aaabe216351b0bdfb51667`.

See `source-ledger.json` for all original paths, byte lengths, raw SHA and temporary formatted SHA. `pretty/` files are parser/formatter derivatives of those exact raw inputs, **not maintained src**. Line references below refer to these temporary derivatives because original JS is minified; original filename/SHA binds each reference.

The anonymous live remote entry pages were fetched only after root authorization: `https://ai-generator.tuanjie.cn/lab3d?embed=1&host=codely` and `https://ai-generator.tuanjie.cn/generation-history?embed=1&host=codely`. Both returned HTTP 200, 2,785 bytes, HTML SHA `22db7818aa29e2ccb1a852f6e17bc182f8bb6ad5385c790555a941dd33316d35`. Their HTML directly references `https://ai.cdn.tuanjie.cn/static/dist/assets/index-DZWJHC3S.js`: HTTP 200, 2,400,014 bytes, SHA `10e0e9c2a6771c22eb65c205fab910a1779794c689e8523f97d8f831eed19d9d`. No analytics JS was fetched. `public-ledger.json` and `public-formatted-ledger.json` preserve provenance and capture times. `pretty-public/index-DZWJHC3S.js` is a parse/format derivative. **This is the current public deployment, not bytes embedded in the EXE and not a proved September-29 screenshot version.**

- `Jm/FG/QG:38401`: Canvas iframe is `https://aicanvas.tuanjie.cn/home`. It validates both exact source window and origin, handles `ai-canvas-ready`, and sends theme/workspace descriptors; token transfer code exists but no real token was read. Canvas gallery/node application belongs to the other read-only team audit.
- `Jv:38316` sends `{type:'codely:prefill',prefill}`. `kG:38321` receives `codely:ready` from the exact creator/history window, synchronizes auth/theme/locale; auth is a protocol field, not inspected account state.
- `PG:38854` accepts history iframe messages `codely:create-now`, `codely:regenerate {prefill}`, `codely:use-reference {payload}`, `codely:local-artifact-request {payload:{requestId,taskId}}`, and `codely:reveal-artifact`. `Hl` bounds IDs to 1..512 non-control characters. Download message is `codely:download {url,filename}`, forwarded to native `/api/tauri/download-url` with blob/browser fallback. Message-origin/source checks remain explicit.
- Chat reference bridge: original `VscTheme-BExNMG_K.js:116671` declares `generation/useAsReference` / `generation/useAsReferenceResult`. `RTt` loads CORS-enabled image, constrains to 1024 px (`MTt`), JPEG quality 0.7 (`NTt`), generates thumbnail; input handler 116982 consumes `{requestId,title,imageUrl,sessionId?}`, opens/selects target chat and attaches image, returning `{requestId,ok,error?}`. Source: https://aicanvas.tuanjie.cn/assets/index-A8ll_iBT.js, 2030171 bytes, SHA 037278e934adbf3e999f1205bd656ebf3cf87f68fd6bdcd32b7f446928fd8b82. Raw and formatted sizes/SHA were verified before parsing. No new network/API, original executable or bundle evaluation.

Actual aB maps imageGenNode→Mz, videoGenNode→Pz, audioGenNode→Bz, modelGenNode→Hz. These are result renderers; shared GR is the real prompt/config/generation editor, delegating yR/LR/eR/DR then Ge. sF resolves incoming edges by target, reads source-node output fields, and combines them with local node inputs. Results return into images/videos/audios/modelUrls and become the next node's linked input.

Preferred calls are schema-driven: uD/YS load server metadata/inputParams/taskLifecycle/outputMapping. GR.Be→oC→cC→mC→dC/fC is the real path. Create method/path, poll interval/path/states and most per-model parameter enums are unavailable without those server schemas; this audit deliberately does not fetch them or invent them. Image/video retain named legacy adapters; model generation explicitly errors if required schema is missing. AbortSignal stops waiting, not a demonstrated server cancel/rollback.

Per-kind fields, branches, real output/preview/history handling and 19 parser-selected raw byte ranges are in canvas-generation-node-audit.json and canvas-node-raw-ranges.json. Raw start/end byte offsets and sliceSHA bind references; listed line numbers refer only to verified Prettier derivatives. This is current remote deployment and not proof of EXE-embedded or historical screenshot version.
